description: Lets local MCP clients discover published agents, delegate with scoped credentials, and read run state and output from a self-hosted Open Agent API gateway.

notes: The last argument is a private file with a scoped key for the self-hosted gateway. Use a read-only key for discovery. Grant invoke only for delegation. Do not use an admin key.
Published v0.0.64 MCPB initialized over stdio on macOS arm64. Local discovery and rejection of invocation with a read-only key were tested; no online model or desktop-client installation was tested.
